simple.meaning: רֹק (rôq) is a Hebrew word meaning “spittle.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: רֹק (H7536) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Job 7:19, with occurrences in Job, Isaiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to רֹק (H7536) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in רֹק (H7536) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: רֹק (rôq) / H7536 is traced through Job 7:19, Job 30:10, Isaiah 50:6 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
